decisions.reason: The supplier explicitly uses h in J, beta in inverse J and an arbitrary positive hbar in J s, whereas this item left those conventions implicit. This is a nonfatal specification defect: the product density depends only on beta h, and all four proof steps use that density, never hbar or time evolution. Any positive hbar gives the same nonnormal state. The repair declares all units, matrix type, dynamics and strip width, and retains the supplier finite-matrix hypotheses without changing the nonnormality claim or projection argument.

The repair supplies the omitted convention for every positive hbar and retains the exact conditional finite-matrix interfaces. Corrected the ancillary Ruelle locator after consulting Chapter 1 sections 4-5, printed pages 9-10; its propositions are stated without proofs and are not used in place of the local argument. This is the native review of this repair, not independent review.
